purpose: Read-only official city registry and public map service review; no property lookup.
assessment: The state Instituto Registral y Catastral operates IDECATQ with Querétaro municipal urban-parcel layer M14_PA; the municipal Dirección de Catastro administers local cadastral records. The WMS is public, but WFS is explicitly disabled. Public Identify links to cadastral cédula fields including owner, address and valuation; no feature query was made. The informational disclaimer is not the access limitation.

officialEvidence.observation: Official IDECATQ public viewer; municipality selector identifies Querétaro as code 14 and the client configures urban parcel layer M14_PA.
Official state cadastral institution lists cadastral-record and cartography services.
Official state registry/cadastre portal describes citizen cadastral and registry services.
Official municipality planning map page and land-use lookup.
Municipal instrument assigns local cadastral-registrar functions over parcels in the municipality.

serviceTrace.observation: Public WMS map metadata confirms layer M14_PA but does not return full polygon geometry. The WFS endpoint explicitly reports “Service WFS is disabled”; the WMS Identify route can expose owner, address and value attributes, so it was not queried.

metadataOnlyRequests.observation: IDECATQ viewer shell; municipality selector contains QUERÉTARO code 14. Client JavaScript configures public WMS and urban parcel layer M14_PA.

WMS Capabilities declares queryable M14_PA layer in EPSG:32614 and CRS:84, extent [-100.5895544,20.5377089,-100.3258632,20.9241908]. WUP point falls inside the bounding extent only; no parcel hit was tested.
OGC exception report states “Service WFS is disabled”; no vector feature request was made.
